title: Swipe-to-send payment and confirmation wave
blurb: Slide a vertical range input inside one ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas to gather luminous energy under a live payment receipt, then release past 92% or tap Confirm to fire a radial chromatic distortion wave.
question: Can a real semantic <dl> payment receipt and a vertical <input type="range"> control render inside one ElementGL WebGL 2 pass so sliding to pay gathers energy beneath the thumb and committing fires a radial distortion shockwave with RGB chromatic fringes across the live DOM receipt?
result: Measured in headless Chrome 160 Canary (2026-11-27): 5/5 live checks pass (1.12 MP, 9.0 MB at 412 px DPR 2.625); one ElementGL bleed canvas drives a vertical range swipe slider past a 92% spring threshold and triggers a radial chromatic distortion wave over a live payment receipt. Real Android hardware stays not verified.
